description:
Which version of my listing is better? Compares two listings of the same category.
(¿Qué versión de mi ficha es mejor?)

Returns the diagnosis of each one (`a` and `b`), the difference in Wintraits Match Index points, a conclusion and
the attributes read that differ between them. On the free plan both are shown in the free view.

Args:
    ficha_a: {"titulo", "precio_eur", "num_imagenes", "vinetas", "descripcion", "volumen_ml"} of the first.
    ficha_b: the same for the second (e.g. another version of the same listing).
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en" (attribute names in English).

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_comparar_fichas
